actors.name: Managing Director
actors.private_context: The managing director of Torchlight Media knows the restructuring decision and must decide whether and when to inform staff. They are aware of the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September.

actors.name: Staff of Torchlight Media
actors.private_context: The staff are aware that a restructuring decision is pending but have not been informed of the details. They expect communication from management.

shared_context: Torchlight Media is undergoing a restructuring process. The works council has a consultation deadline at the end of September 2026. The managing director has the authority to inform staff about the decision.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. No communication about the restructuring decision has occurred yet.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the managing director actually informed the staff of the restructuring decision before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
